 Search K-Drama Fans, This One's for You: 7-Eleven Combines Korean Food Favorites With a New Romance Series— "A Convenient Love" (사랑마트)
 lewishooper1 3 hours ago 3 min read 7-ELEVEN PRESENTS: LOVE MART (사랑마트) - adweek.com Convenience stores have become cemented in Korean culture, and that is evident in K-dramas and even music videos. 
 One of the big convenience store players, 7-Eleven , is redefining food advertising by pairing Korean-inspired menus with original romance in a brand-new micro-series called Love Mart  (사랑마트). 
 7-Eleven has hit the nail on the head; by combining viral snack items with serial K-drama storytelling, the convenience giant has the potential to turn standard promotional ads into bingeable social media content that we cannot wait to watch! 
 About the Drama 
 This highly anticipated drama is set around a late-night convenience store, Love Mart . The story follows two main characters whose paths constantly cross over midnight snack runs. 
 Talk about romantic! The short-form series captures classic K-drama romance tropes and dramatic slow-motion gazes, using late-night food cravings as the ultimate catalyst for love, while also incorporating real-life situations that we can all relate to. 
 About the Characters 
 This new drama will follow two young students whose lives are intertwined most of the time during late-night food runs at their local 7-Eleven store . 
 This is something that most of us can relate to. However, through the two students' reactions, it becomes apparent that a store employee starts to act more like a mentor than a cashier by using brand-new menu items to spark a romantic conversation between the two students. 
 R elease Date and Where to Watch 
 The seven-episode mini-series premiered on November 2, 2026 , with new 60-second clips dropping every Monday and Thursday through November 23 . You are able to stream the episodes on the official Instagram and TikTok channels for both 7-Eleven and Speedway! 
 This is such a Gen-Z-friendly way to watch content, so we can definitely see this series going viral. 
 About the Products on Offer 
 Within the show, there are many delicious food products on offer. Partnered with Korean food giant CJ Bibigo , we are able to see many of our favourite go-to items, such as authentic regional spices like sweet and spicy gochujang . 
 One of the favorites of our writer, Lewis Hooper , is the crisp Gochujang Boneless Wings, which have become a part of his movie night routine. 
 But that's not all! Other classics, such as spicy chicken dumplings, fusion egg sandos, and Korean BBQ-infused roller grill favourites, will also feature in the show! 
 This is enough to make you hungry, even if you have already eaten! 
 Of course, if you live in Korea or have ever visited, you will be fully aware of the true cravings that make you want to visit your local 7-Eleven store at night to get some late-night snacks! 
 Why This Is Important for 7-Eleven 
 7-Eleven is a massive part of Korean culture. It is accessible, open mostly 24 hours, and has all the go-to essential items and late-night snacks that you could possibly imagine. 
 Rather than just relying on the usual skippable ads that people don't want to watch, 7-Eleven is now actively using tried-and-tested Gen-Z-friendly content. 
 This involves snackable, high-engagement content and even cross-posting on social media sites like Instagram and TikTok. Integrating product discounts directly into episode releases seamlessly converts passive viewers into active store visitors. 
 Why This Is Significant 
 This brand-new campaign is also all about connecting K-culture , K-pop , and K-drama into one central TV indulgence and retail magnet. 
 By mixing these together with traditional Korean narrative styles, 7-Eleven sets a new standard for modern lifestyle branding that we are sure will take off following the drama's release. 
 Final Thoughts 
 The Dojeon Media team really supports the concept of adding household brands such as 7-Eleven. It helps to create a sense of familiarity that can also allow the audience to build a connection with the characters. 
 This also allows simple storytelling to go much further and creates slightly higher-tier content. We are sure that 7-Eleven will be able to successfully sell a full late-night mood, culture, and experience to the audience and gain a trending Gen-Z following. 
 What is your go-to late-night convenience store food? Comment below!
